notes.title: Snowflake's Chance 1.2 Brutal Mode / Re-orchestrated Soundtrack Patch released
notes.notes:
[b]Snowflake's Chance 1.2 Brutal Mode/Re-orchestrated Soundtrack Patch released[/b]

Patch Notes:

[b]Re-orchestrated and improved soundtrack[/b] - Reworked and improved stage tracks, new menu music, entire soundtrack remastered and re-imagined.
  The old soundtrack will still be included in the DLC in addition to the new version. 

[b]Brutal Mode added [/b](Brutal Mode unlocks after completing Normal Mode)
BRUTAL FEATURES:- Altered levels with more spikes and hazards
			- Enemies and hazards are faster and tougher
			- Enemy variants (Batghoul Queens and Purple Ghost Dogs)
			- Spiders
			- Fall damage
			- Rarer item spawns
			- Less early game checkpoints
			- Certain doom

			:snowflake:

Minor additions and fixes:	
* "Brutal Boots" Achievement added
* Final checkpoint raised to higher in the stage.
* Changes made to loading a save of a completed game; Player will consistently be taken to   the final checkpoint rather than the End Screen if they immediately re-enter the game
* Audio system optimised for performance
* Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause snowflake to become stuck when taking two sources of damage at once
* Bug fix for Puppies sometimes getting stuck on the ceiling 
* Fixed a bug that would allow a door to open without a Monkey Paw/Crab Claw key being     used (Thank you RCHelicoptr)
* Bug fix for Batghouls getting stuck on the walls while stunned
* Minor aesthetic additions to surface area.
* Batghouls optimised for performance
* Default joystick sensitivity changed to 7
* Hidden artifacts added - (another way uap?)
* Minor texture and animation improvements
* Completion of "Do No Harm", "Going Up" and "Bauble Collector" achievements will carry   through progress to fresh installations 
* Touched up UI for player HP

The patch will download automatically through Steam.

For anyone so inclined:
1.1.5 will be still be playable in Steam by accessing the Betas tab of the game properties window in your Steam browser.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27676904/312e26404470c4b7c3f449b4c157206d105e88e7.jpg[/img]
